claimScope: Two source-bound writer-stream-seed-1234 regimes, with a complete native metadata observer and fresh no-probe controls for the current 768x1080 regime.

firstObservedBoundaryDifference.scope: The probe samples function boundaries only; it does not identify which internal instruction or external API produced the change.

selectCanvas.scope: The same observed ACLWIN::SQUARE argument leads to different recorded canvas widths in the two regimes; this is a bounded observation, not a general selection rule.
